safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state that the patient has no history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient denies any prior anaphylaxis can distort risk stratification in an acute insect sting with breathing concerns, potentially prompting unnecessary escalation (e.g., ED referral, epinephrine planning) or confusing future clinicians reviewing the note. The error is unlikely to directly cause physical harm in this encounter but can lead to inefficient or overly cautious management.

This is more likely to cause unnecessary additional questioning or conservative management rather than direct injury.
